attestations.text: CH'ÊN Mêng-lei 陳夢雷 (T. 則震, H. 省齋, 天一道人), b. 1651, scholar, was a native of Hou-kuan (Foochow). In 1670, at twenty sui, be became a chin-shih and was selected a bachelor of the Hanlin Academy.
